title: Constructing Dynamic Master Logic Models as Knowledge Graphs for Complex System Diagnostics Using Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.12304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic Master Logic (DML) provides a hierarchical framework for representing system behavior by linking functional objectives to underlying structural elements. However, DML construction typically relies on expert interpretation of technical documentation, limiting scalability for complex systems. This study presents a framework for automated construction of DML models from system descriptions and their representation as Knowledge Graphs (KG-DML), using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Large Language Models as enabling tools. Building on prior work with small-scale systems, the framework extends automated KG-DML construction and evaluation to substantially larger and more complex systems. Model construction proceeds across the DML hierarchy using targeted retrieval while preserving functional dependencies and explicit logical relationships. translated_title: 构建动态主逻辑模型作为知识图谱，用于基于检索增强大型语言模型的复杂系统诊断
translated_abstract: 动态主逻辑（DML）通过将功能目标与底层结构元素相连接，提供了一种表示系统行为的层次化框架。然而，DML的构建通常依赖专家对技术文档的解读，这限制了其在复杂系统中的可扩展性。本研究提出了一种从系统描述中自动构建DML模型并将其表示为知识图谱（KG-DML）的框架，利用检索增强生成和大型语言模型作为使能工具。在先前针对小规模系统工作的基础上，该框架将自动化KG-DML构建与评估扩展到了规模更大、复杂度更高的系统。模型构建过程沿DML层次结构进行，通过有针对性的检索，同时保留功能依赖关系和显式逻辑关系。生成的KG-DML支持诊断推理、安全评估和向上故障传播分析。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种利用检索增强大型语言模型自动从系统描述中构建动态主逻辑知识图谱（KG-DML）的框架，并将其扩展到复杂大型系统，以支持诊断推理和故障传播分析。
en_tdlr: This study presents a framework for automatically constructing Dynamic Master Logic knowledge graphs (KG-DML) from system descriptions using retrieval-augmented large language models, extending it to complex large-scale systems to support diagnostic reasoning and failure propagation analysis.
